metadata.name: dp_id
metadata.description: The main unique ESO archive file identifier

metadata.name: date_obs
metadata.description: The content of the DATE_OBS keyword exposed as a string and not a datetime field (ESO_DATEADD_SEC does not work on this column, use exp_start instead).

metadata.name: origfile
metadata.description: The original file name as used on the instrument workstation at the telescope. Read from keyword ORIGFILE. Example: HD75289_0012.fits

metadata.name: access_url
metadata.description: A URL that can be used to download the raw file; if the file is under proprietary period, only authenticated users with the necessary access rights will be given access to it.

metadata.name: datalink_url
metadata.description: A URL that can be used to find the access points of the raw file itself, and of all its related files. Related files are: the calibration files necessary to reduce a science raw frame (see calSelector entries), and, if available, a (list of) calibrated product(s) generated out of it.)

metadata.name: access_estsize
metadata.description: Estimated size of the downloaded file in KBytes. It is only "estimated" as in general, FITS headers can be patched at download time, making the file size varying with time.)
